name: Bad Day
overview: Scripture reveals that during bad days and times of trouble, God is our unwavering refuge and strength, offering comfort and deliverance to the oppressed and righteous alike. Though we may endure weeping and hardship, His anger is brief and His favor brings life and joy, reminding believers that even in the darkest valleys, His presence and guidance bring peace and hope. Calling upon the Lord in our distress invites His deliverance and glorifies Him, assuring us that no trouble is beyond His help.
